gaps_and_limits: Both fail scores concern narrowly missing explicit disclosures within partly satisfied compound criteria. Alternative interpretations are recorded alongside the scores rather than hidden.
The baseline skill source was not used to infer whether either omission is a missing rule or an execution failure; that distinction is not assessable from the saved answers alone.
The responses propose simulated actions. The evaluation does not assert that project records were changed or that external actions did or did not occur.
No real commands, live integration checks, deployment, or host enforcement were evaluated. Runtime and model identifiers were not supplied and were not guessed.
These seven simulated answers do not establish reliability across other scenarios or products.
